run_hydra_app: run the hydra app my_app that prints the resolved config as YAML
register_config_store: register a dataclass Config as base_config in Hydra's ConfigStore for structured configs
register_external_configs: call database_lib.register_configs to register external database config schemas from a library
print_config_yaml: print the resolved Hydra config as YAML using OmegaConf.to_yaml
review_Config_class: review the Config dataclass that defines db and debug fields for structured configuration
